requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x0000CCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] is written with 0xCCCC after calling the start function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x0000AAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] is written with 0xAAAA after calling the refresh function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] is written with 0x5555 after calling the enable access function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write any value other than 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] is written with 0x00000000 after calling the disable access function.
